comment: One entry per moment. scripts/motion-trace.mjs reads this file. duration takes units, as CSS does: "350ms" or ".35s". easing is a cubic-bezier, or linear. trigger is load, hover, click, focus or scroll. reducedMotion says what must happen when the reader asks for less motion: instant (lands in one frame) or fade (opacity only, under 150ms).

moments.why: The first line comes into focus once, so the reader's eye lands on it.
Shows which card the pointer is on without a color change.
